subject: Issues combining telemetry objects with different error models

messages.author: 26c46dd11cb9f896
messages.subject: Issues combining telemetry objects with different error models
parts:
Hi Chris,

First off, thanks so much for all your assistance so far!

I've been working on incorporating both the VHF and GPS logger telemetry sets into HR analysis. I fit uere models from stationary loggers to assign to the GPS logger data and I assign a constant value for the uere of the VHF telemetry.

However, when I attempt to combine the two telemetry objects with tbind(), I get this error:
 
Error in `$<-.data.frame`(S3Part(x, TRUE), name, value) :
  replacement has 0 rows, data has 644

This error does not occur when I don't assign the telemetry objects an uere model, so I assume having two different error structures are causing an issue combining the telemetry objects.

Thanks!

Please send me a minimal working example and I'll get that error fixed. The intent of tbind() is exactly for what you are trying to do.

Best,

messages.author: 40fd627580dd34f5
messages.subject: Re: Issues combining telemetry objects with different error models
parts:
Hi Steve,

Your code actually works for me on the development version of the package: devtools::install_github("ctmm-initiative/ctmm")
Two warnings are given:
1: In tbind(cs_vhf_tel, cs_gps_tel) :
  Inconsistent location classes renamed.
2: In tbind(cs_vhf_tel, cs_gps_tel) :
  Re-projecting due to inconsistent projections.
because the two datasets started with different projections before tbind(), and because each dataset contained no class information to distinguish them.

Best,
Chris
